summary: Backend-only testing of CashKlick admin/quiz/survey/visit features. Wrote 22 pytest cases covering admin login, /config admob defaults, quiz/survey daily (20 Q, deterministic, ad-gated submit, points 50-200, dedupe), admin quiz-bank (100+ q) & survey-bank (50+ q) CRUD, admin ads update reflecting in /config, admin visits CRUD, visit complete points 50-100, and tasks/submit without screenshot. All 22 tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1170 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, tasks, earn, admin) for maintainability.
POST /api/admin/visits does not validate required 'name'/'url' fields (will 500 if missing). Consider Pydantic body model.
POST /api/quiz/submit & survey/submit currently trust client 'ad_watched' boolean — no server-side rewarded-ad verification. Acceptable for AdMob test build, but document as known limitation.
PUT /api/admin/ads stores empty string when a field is omitted; consider preserving previous value or rejecting empty IDs.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed quiz/survey/visit/task docs and clean them up. Demo user (demo_session_token_001) may now have quiz/survey/visit completions recorded for today (IST) — re-running the ad-gate tests today will be skipped/expected-409 by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-running the suite the same day will skip the 'quiz_submit_credits_points' and 'survey_submit_ad_gate_and_dedupe' positive paths because the demo user is already marked completed (tests use pytest.skip in that case — not a failure). To re-run those, either wait until next IST day or clear db.quiz_completions / db.survey_completions for demo_user_001.
